purpose: Teach: 議長/座長/委任/定額/賃貸/図面/法制/県知事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、議長、絶対、として、絶対、業界、絶対、率いていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the early days, your father—he truly led the industry as chairman with absolute dedication.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate cadence. Weight on each achievement. Gazing into memory. Pride mixed with something tender and final. A father speaking about legacy he has carried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、業界会議の、絶対、座長、絶対、引き継いでまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, I have continued that industry leadership role with the same commitment. I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Measured, composed. Respectful bow in the voice—not obsequious, but honoring the handoff. Each phrase lands with quiet sureness. Eyes meeting his.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、信頼の、絶対、委任、絶対、状、絶対、いくつも、絶対、受けたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father received so many letters of trust and delegation. So many.
lines.style: Voice softens on 'so many.' Not listing accomplishments but touching them gently, like old photographs. A slight catch—the weight of what was entrusted. Small pause before the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、定額、絶対、サービス、絶対、提供、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's era, I have continued to provide the same steady, reliable service. I carry that forward with gratitude.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not boasting—stating a lineage. Slight emphasis on 'continued' and 'carry forward.' Steady breath. The tone of someone who understands inheritance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、賃貸、絶対、契約、絶対、自分で、絶対、交渉したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father negotiated the rental contracts himself. Handled every detail with his own hands.
lines.style: Admiration softening into melancholy. Each word deliberate. A slight exhale on 'himself'—as if marveling at a younger man's work ethic. Trailing off slightly, letting that sink in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代の、本気で、絶対、図面、絶対、ばあさんが、絶対、大切に、絶対、保管しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The blueprints from my father's time—my grandmother has kept them carefully all these years. They're safe with her.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender. The mention of grandmother adds warmth. Slower pace on 'kept them carefully'—honoring both the document and the care. A small smile lives in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、法制、絶対、改正、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応してきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father responded to every change in the law with care and integrity. He met each one thoughtfully.
lines.style: Steady respect. No rush. Emphasis on 'thoughtfully'—this was not bureaucratic, it was conscious. The voice of someone witnessing another's character. Slight pause at the end, like a nod.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気for、絶対、県知事、絶対、と、絶対、丁寧な、絶対、ご縁、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, the relationship with the prefectural governor has continued with the same care and courtesy. Those bonds remain.
lines.style: Clear, present-tense steadiness. 'Those bonds remain' lands with quiet certainty—not anxiety, but the calm of roots that hold. Composed but warm. A closing tone: grateful, complete.
